|---|---|---|---|

**Severity:** P2, because a tired rota misses pages, though no missed page is on record. · **Decision:** proposed · **Implementation:** absent · **Verification:** untested.

**What we see.** A median of 3.1 incidents per 12-hour shift in one quarter (E-110). Gap G-14.

**Why it matters.** Load above the limit wears the rota down and slows the response.
